title: Go live
loadFailed: Could not load Studio. Retrying automatically.

header.endConfirmBody: OBS is disconnected and a replay is created. Viewers who rewound can keep watching to the end.
header.endFailed: Could not end the stream, try again.

preview.label: Preview · a few seconds behind OBS
preview.emptyTitle: The preview appears when OBS starts streaming
preview.emptyBody: Open OBS and press "Start Streaming" — the status updates by itself, no reload needed.

health.title: Stream health
health.interrupted: Lost the OBS signal. The stream ends in {{seconds}}s unless it reconnects.
health.fpsNote: Frames per second processed by the server
health.justEnded: Ended. Press "Stop Streaming" in OBS; you can go live again in 30 seconds.
health.idle: Metrics appear when OBS starts sending.

warnings.slow: The server is falling behind (speed {{speed}}x) — lower the resolution or bitrate in OBS.
warnings.bitrate: Bitrate {{bitrate}} kbps is above the recommended {{target}} kbps.

key.title: OBS connection
key.subtitle: RTMP · 1 source at a time
key.none: You have no stream key yet. Create one to stream with OBS.
key.saveNow: Save this key now: for security it will not be shown again. Never share your key.
key.securityNote: The key is shown only once when created and stored only as a hash. Never share your key.
key.createdToastBody: Copy it into OBS now: it will not be shown again.
key.createFailed: Could not create the key, try again.
key.regenerateBody: The old key stops working right away. OBS using the old key cannot stream until you paste the new one.

settings.title: Stream info
settings.appliesNow: Applies right away to the current stream
settings.tagsHint: Enter or comma to add · up to {{max}} characters per tag
settings.matureHint: Viewers must confirm their age before watching

stream.title: Settings → Stream
stream.body: Service: Custom… then paste the Server and Stream key above.

output.title: Output (Advanced)
output.body: Encoder x264 or NVENC H.264, Rate control CBR.

stop.title: Stop for real
stop.body: Press "Stop Streaming" in OBS: if you only press End here, OBS may reconnect by itself.

noVideo.title: No picture?
noVideo.body: Check the key, and that only one source streams to the channel at a time.

notCreator.title: You do not have a Creator channel yet
notCreator.body: The Studio is for Creators. Apply to become one; once approved, your channel is created automatically and the Studio opens.
notCreator.preparing: Your channel is being prepared, the Studio opens in a moment…
